resources.string: This permission lets Waypoint read how long you use each app, so a widget can auto-track habits like "limit social media." It is never sent off your device.
This permission lets Waypoint read health data (steps, workouts, sleep) from Health Connect so widgets can auto-mark habits done. All data stays on your device.
Lets the bedtime screen\'s Go to sleep button turn your screen off, like the power button. Waypoint doesn\'t read or watch anything on your screen with it.
